title: Does GTA 6 Have Fast Travel? Yes, But Skipping the Ride Costs $100 🚕 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has no map-teleport menu. You fast travel by calling Paradise Taxi from your phone (available after the first mission) or the RydeMe rideshare app (unlocked after the Chapter 1 mission "Buck Me", paid from your bank account). "Skip Journey" costs an extra $100, "Hurry Up" costs $5, and skipping also moves the in-game clock forward. Cabs can't reach remote keys or deep swamp areas.

Sources: GTABase (How to Fast Travel in GTA 6), BGR.
Images: Rockstar Games (official trailers).
